item.title: AI accelerator shipments are set to turn advanced packaging into the next battleground: Counterpoint
item.summary: AI accelerator shipments are expected to reshape semiconductor demand worldwide, with implications for cloud operators, memory suppliers, and device makers in every major market. Counterpoint expects more than 130 million GPUs and AI ASICs to shift toward advanced-packaged on-compute memory over the next five years, as the industry braces for nearly US$2 trillion in compute revenue and an intensifying battle over packaging capacity.
